description: This file defines the PHP class EmailsViewPopup, which extends the ViewPopup class and adds a public property $bean, representing an Email object. It appears to be part of the view layer for displaying email popups within SuiteCRM, an extension of SugarCRM.

classes.name: EmailsViewPopup
classes.description: A class extending ViewPopup, used for rendering email popup views in SuiteCRM. Contains an Email bean property.
